exposure: degree of perineal trauma (intact perineum, spontaneous perineal trauma, episiotomy, second degree tear, third or fourth degree tear)
cohort: The study included 3479 women who gave birth vaginally at the Mancha-Centro Hospital.
finding: Episiotomy is related to a greater reduction of haemoglobin concentration compared to all degrees of spontaneous perineal trauma.
mod_finding: Episiotomy, a specific mode of birth intervention, leads to a greater reduction of haemoglobin concentration compared to spontaneous perineal trauma.
